prompts.saqueTile:
Use case: illustration-story / game asset. Generate ONE original game-board special-tile artwork for "SAQUE" in the cheerful premium cartoon 3D Brazilian board game Império Urbano. Transparent background outside the tile. This tile means collecting the communal tax jackpot.
A horizontal rounded rectangular physical board tile viewed straight-on, no perspective skew, thick polished gold bevel and fine purple inner trim matching a colorful Brazilian property board. Rich deep emerald-to-turquoise illustrated interior, small warm golden glow. On the RIGHT two-thirds show a beautiful open brass-and-wood communal treasury chest overflowing with shiny golden coins and a few stylized unmarked green notes, a small trail of coins coming outward toward the foreground suggesting payout. Rewarding, friendly board-game illustration, NOT crime or theft, no masked thief, no person, no weapon. On the LEFT third preserve a calm relatively empty deep-emerald area to overlay the label later. No floating coins outside the actual tile edges. No text, letters, numerals, currency marks, logos or interface panels anywhere; "SAQUE" will be live typography added separately. Detailed handcrafted cartoon 3D style, rich material shading, upper-left lighting, bright readable silhouette, not photorealistic. Overall tile aspect about 2:1, large high-resolution source, tile fills most of canvas with minimal transparent padding. One reusable isolated tile only, not a board or a sheet of variants.
prompts.taxPoolMarker: Use case: game UI asset. Create ONE reusable isolated communal TAX JACKPOT COUNTER ornament for the premium colorful cartoon 3D Brazilian tabletop game Império Urbano. True transparent background. A compact polished golden shallow coin bowl / treasury pot with several stacked gold coins sits just ABOVE and behind a wide empty dark-indigo enamel number plaque with warm beveled brass rim. Coins look like friendly game tokens, no currency signs, no real-world money reproduction. A subtle small downward collection chute/slot in the pot suggests incoming payments. No people, hands or thieves. The blank plaque occupies the lower half to two-thirds of the ornament, wide uncluttered center suitable for later overlay of changing amounts such as a currency total, but DO NOT render any numeral, text, letters, symbols, amount or label. The total is dynamic and must not be baked in. Orthographic front view, axis aligned, soft upper-left warm lighting, cheerful polished detailed cartoon 3D style matching gold/indigo board HUD, tasteful realistic bevels and small intrinsic shadow. Avoid huge empty borders, keep the whole ornament visible. About 2:1 overall shape, high-resolution, minimal transparent padding. Single original object only, no scene, contact sheet, tile or second variant.
prompts.boardConcept:
Edit the approved full-window Império Urbano gameplay concept. Preserve its continuous tabletop, large board, four player plaques, coffee, coins, plant, Menu, Histórico and bottom action dock. No property clipboard. This is a VISUAL PROPOSAL, not implemented software.

Make this EXACT requested board change while keeping START:
1. The physical START/INÍCIO corner stays at the upper-left corner.
2. Insert ONE property tile RN / "Rio Grande do Norte" directly AFTER INÍCIO and BEFORE AM / Amazonas along the top edge, immediately to the LEFT of Amazonas. It features colorful Brazilian dunes/beach and a fort. Reflow the TOP tiles with narrower widths to fit the extra tile; do not remove any existing state or corner.
3. Remove RN from its OLD left-edge location between CE and AL. Replace that exact old RN location with a special green treasure-chest tile labelled clearly "SAQUE", using the supplied green/gold original asset as style. There is ONLY ONE RN tile, now on the top edge, and ONLY ONE SAQUE tile, on the left edge.
4. Keep the TAXA tile in its existing bottom-edge location. Show a compact integrated amount plaque ON that Taxa tile: small "ACUMULADO" and readable "R$ 600". Use the supplied coin-pot/indigo plaque style for this indicator, small enough not to cover neighboring tiles. R$600 is an illustrative current communal tax pool. No value or pot goes into a separate sidebar.
5. Preserve all other spaces and their identities, and preserve the center Brazilian landscape and logo. This proposal has 34 spaces instead of 33.

Exact clockwise order starting with upper-left corner: INÍCIO, RN, AM, RR, EVENTO, AP, PA, RO, OLIMPÍADAS, AC, MT, MS, GO, EVENTO, DF, MG, ES, DESCANSO, RJ, PR, SP, TAXA, RS, SC, PE, PB, AEROPORTO, BA, SE, AL, SAQUE, CE, PI, MA, then back to INÍCIO.
Therefore along the TOP from LEFT to RIGHT must visibly be INÍCIO / RN / AM / RR / EVENTO / AP / PA / RO / OLIMPÍADAS. Along the LEFT edge from TOP to BOTTOM must be MA / PI / CE / SAQUE / AL / SE / BA between the two corners. Never duplicate RN, never delete INÍCIO, never place SAQUE where another state belongs.

Keep premium colorful cartoon 3D art direction, coherent lighting, contact shadows and warm brass/wood materials. Preserve complete board perimeter and controls inside the image. Single wide landscape concept, no explanatory annotations, no arrows outside the scene, no comparison panels. Input 1 is the edit target; input 2 supplies the new Saque art; input 3 supplies the empty live tax counter style.
